# media commands

Every `media` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `media:drain`

Generate queued media variants directly from the database — no queue broker required

```bash
bin/semitexa media:drain
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--limit` | yes |

## `media:failed-variants`

List failed media variant generation jobs

```bash
bin/semitexa media:failed-variants
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--limit` | yes |
| `--asset` | yes |

## `media:import`

Bulk-backfill a directory of existing files into media assets with queued variants

```bash
bin/semitexa media:import "<source>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--collection` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--created-by` | yes |
| `--ext` | yes |
| `--no-recursive` | no |
| `--limit` | yes |
| `--force-duplicates` | no |
| `--dry-run` | no |
| `--sync` | no |

## `media:quota:recalculate`

Recalculate tenant media quota usage from authoritative asset table

```bash
bin/semitexa media:quota:recalculate "<tenant-id>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--bucket` | yes |

## `media:regenerate`

Queue variant regeneration for one asset or all assets in a collection

```bash
bin/semitexa media:regenerate ["asset-id"]
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--variant` | yes |
| `--collection` | yes |
| `--tenant` | yes |
| `--batch` | yes |

## `media:work`

Run the dedicated media variant generation worker

```bash
bin/semitexa media:work ["transport"] ["queue"]
```
